the development and evaluation of BP prediction and modeling using statistical and computational intelligence methods.

the BP is strongly associated with the age, pulse rate and alcohol consumption, but the association is non-linear and complex.
the ANN model with the GA training algorithm is a better approach for the prediction of blood pressure than statistical approaches.
the ANN model is better than the multiple regression models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BP modeling is a very complex problem and the results of this study indicate that the BP is a function of many factors.
, the BP modeling using ANN is a powerful technique to analyze and predict the cardiovascular risk.
BP is a complex process and it is very difficult to model it with a single model.

the ANN model can be used to predict the blood pressure parameters with better accuracy.
, the statistical and computational intelligence methods are very effective in modeling of BP.
